summary: After migrating, custom module_utils can't be imported from ansible.module_utils since collections aren't merged into that namespace; use from ansible_collections.<ns>.<coll>.plugins.module_utils.<util> import ..., also for subclassed plugins.
questions: Why can't my module import its custom module_util after moving to a collection?
What's the import path for a module_util in a collection?

answer_card.title: Update module_utils imports after migration
answer_card.answer_md:
Collection content isn't merged into `ansible.module_utils`, so change imports to:
```text
from ansible_collections.{namespace}.{collectionname}.plugins.module_utils.{util} import {something}
```
Apply the same rules to subclassed plugins.
